name: Kilnfire Terraces
core_rationale: Upper stepped terracotta rim of Sola's ceramic shield where giant pottery kilns vent warm updrafts toward the eastern root-train viaduct.
local_conflict: Cracked porcelain golems have blocked the Kettle-Whistle Viaduct leading to Continent 02.

mystery_hook.in_world_rumor: Potters claim the upper kiln vents hum in harmony whenever the root-train approaches from the east.
mystery_hook.visual_silhouette: Stepped red-clay amphitheaters crowned by smoking porcelain chimneys.
mystery_hook.unanswered_question: Who locked the Great Kiln damper from the inside?

causal_continuity.evidence: Forms the upper eastern rim of Continent 01 Hearthbloom Basin connecting to the Kettle-Whistle Viaduct.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Stepped terracotta amphitheaters and giant whistling teapot kilns.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: Terrace steps capped at 0.18 meters with 4.0 meter wide glaze-brick ramps for 1.05m characters.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: Draft status: child hunting area tiles for Levels 10 to 20 are being laid out.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Provides mystery_hook for the locked Great Kiln damper without placeholder filler maps.
